review_text: We went here for lunch on a Sunday around noon and only one other customer. The little cafe was clean and inviting. We got a table and were brought menus. You can enter through the jewelry store next door and also there is a second entrance. The menu has some good choices for food and drink and we ordered a Flat White, Affogato à la Maison, Waffles and the Spanish Sardine Panini. The Flat White was full bodied and smooth and the Affogato was as you would expect, bold and creamy, and the pistachio pieces on top really accented it nicely. The sardine panini was light and flavorful with the cheese and sardines complimenting each other. The waffles were cooked perfectly and the light syrup and blueberry jam along with banana made for a special dish. A great dining experience and attentive staff get the five stars!

Here’s a kind and polished review you can use: ⸻ Had a lovely dine-in experience at Cafe de Vivre 🤍 I ordered their Matcha Oat Latte, and it was well-balanced, and comforting, perfect for a slow café moment. The ambiance is warm and inviting, with cozy interiors that make you want to stay a little longer. The staff were also well-spoken, attentive, and genuinely pleasant, which made the visit even better. There is a 5% service charge, which might feel a bit extra, but considering the overall experience, the atmosphere. Definitely a nice spot to unwind and enjoy a quiet café vibe

Had a great experience at Cafe de Vivre. The staff are warm, polite, and easy to talk to. You feel taken care of the moment you walk in. Their coffee stands out. You can tell they know their beans well and take time to get each cup right. Easily one of the best spots for specialty coffee in Davao.

Stumbled upon this quaint cafe inside the mall and it was as if I was transported into the streets of Paris. The vibe was definitely cozy and peaceful as it was located in an isolated spot. It’s the perfect place to dine and slow down. The coffee and food? Hands down one of the best i’ve tasted in town especially the Iced Long Black. You have the freedom to choose the beans according to your preference. The waffles were very generous and the earl grey creme caramel was 👌👌. Classic yet creative in their own way. This cafe is a must-visit and will surely be back!

Their cafe mocha hits you like a train, I love it! Service was a bit slow but understandable as they only had one staff when we were there. He was very accommodating despite that. Small space, good for 1-2 people seating.

Went here for coffee crawl. It's not crowded during the time we visited. We ordered meatball marinara pasta and kaya toast. The serving is good enough for 1 person. Service was fast. Long black was clean and smooth (Ethiopia Niguse Gemeda beans). It is a peaceful pocket inside the mall for a cup of coffee. Airconditioning can be improved though. It seems warm because of the downlights. They are also selling coffee beans.
An underrated small cozy cafe in Abreeza, their hojicha oat latte was great but a bit pricey. It had a nutty flavor with notes of chocolate and seaweed.

My friend ordered a cappuccino and it tasted really good, smooth, balanced, and not too sweet or bitter. The ambiance of the place is also really nice. It’s cozy and relaxing, making it a great spot to hang out or enjoy a quiet break.

Flat White was really good. I liked the touch of them letting me choose the beans I want for my coffee. It really showcases that they are a specialty coffee shop. They roast their own beans and have a display of their beans on their shelves. Place is quiet, nice to stay for a while even when the mall is busy. The lighting is a bit bright for my preference, but nonetheless I had a pleasant experience. Staff was accomodating and service was quick. The panini was delicious. All their food is non-pork. I would like to try their pasta next time I come back.

Really innovative roasts. Their light roast espresso is a very fun drink to start with. And for exploring of specialty coffee. They have a wonderful collection every time i go there. Baristas and staff are super good at their art and for a coffee enthusiast like me. This store is one of the top 3 for davao for overall experience. Just a bit pricey tho but they have a really wide perception in coffee. Bad grammar and punctuation but kayo na bahala make sense HAHAHAHAHAHAHA..got cortado today tho. Youd like their black selection.

₱170 6oz to 8oz cup of Cappuccino in Philippine Bukidnon blend. I didn't choose the blend so it's up to them. It was jackfruity so didn't complain on its induced sweetness from the milk and coffee machine. Did not dine in to avoid 5% dine in fee. My first time seeing that fee in a store. The dining in tables are full by 4pm on Saturday September 27, 2025. Will come back for take out.
Great coffee!! Barista Kat is very friendly and can guide you on what beans will fit you preferences! Happy to find this coffee shop in Davao Abreeza! Getting my second cup now, what palpitations??

This tiny coffee-first café exudes homey vibes. Its contemporary chic invites customers to kick vack, relax, and savor their tasty freshly brewed coffees. Their food choices are also noteworthy, and I would recommend interested people to try the place's pulled chicken sandwich. I'd also like to mention that their kitchen is quite small, so expect to wait longer than usual for your dishes to arrive, especially during peak hours. However, I'd say that customers go here to relax rather than demanding quick coffee fixes. Go here to escape from the mall's fast paced environment.
Located 3rd floor at Abreeza, at the BPO lobby. The meatball marinara and matcha rose were really good. Staff are really kind and attentive Cafe is small but the place was not crowded when I visited.
The staff were well trained. The plating and cakes look good. You have 4 types of coffee mix to choose from. Reasonable taste and slightly pricey for cafe. Recommended!

The food I was exceptionally great. (Pesto Pasta) and the Fizzy Lemonade was also refreshing. Aside from their food the service was also good and fast. The atmosphere was great and relaxing. Ps: I didn’t get to take the picture of the fizzy lemon.

The staff was welcoming and very knowledgeable. They offer a great variety of beans, for the ones who want to learn and appreciate good coffee! I recommend to pair the matcha latte with waffles and the mocha with the chicken sandwich 😍 it felt like a little portal to French lifestyle all the way to Davao.

A new hidden gem in Abreeza Mall! If you're looking for a cozy and calm place to relax/read/work, this is it 😉 The coffee and food are nice too, on the pricier end but you can feel the difference in quality. Highly recommended, will come again ~

Stepping into Café de Vivré felt like discovering a quiet sanctuary in the middle of a busy day. From the very first sip of my coffee, I could immediately tell: this place takes pride in its beans. The aroma was rich and inviting, and the taste—deep, smooth, and wonderfully nuanced—spoke volumes about the quality of the local beans they use. What makes Café de Vivré truly special is their thoughtful commitment to showcasing local coffee. There’s something meaningful about sipping a cup that not only tastes incredible but also supports local growers and reflects the region’s unique character. It’s more than coffee—it’s culture in a cup. The ambiance is warm and welcoming, perfect for both quiet solo moments and good conversations with friends. The staff were genuinely kind, happy to share the story behind their beans and offer recommendations. You can tell they’re passionate about what they serve—and it shows. If you’re someone who appreciates a good cup of coffee that has both depth and a story behind it, I can’t recommend Café de Vivré enough. It’s not just a café—it’s an experience rooted in local pride and exceptional flavor.
The cafe is very cozy and feels home-y. Would recommend going here occasionally!

Glad to find this hidden gem inside the mall. If you want to try specialty coffee, they have a good selection. We tried their panini and it was also great. Space is a bit intimate but a good coffee experience nonetheless.

we ordered the Bukidnon Kalsada Beans in pour-over, it has a very clean aftertaste and the jackfruit and caramel taste profile is really dominant. we also tried the Hojicha Oat. both drinks has interesting taste and so glad that they included our own Philippine Local Beans <3
The coffee is good and its got a little “hidden cafe” vibe since its tucked away in a less crowded space. Highly recommend visiting this place, theyve got solid options for drinks and food

Found this cafe on a chill Wednesday evening in Abreeza. My wife loves the decaf moka we ordered, in her own words - served perfectly warm as requested. The honey yuzu I ordered was also refreshing.
Tried their matcha oat latte and hojicha oat latte — they didn’t disappoint! Both were really good, and the staff were very friendly too!

Out of so many coffee shops in Davao, I've never seen a place that put this amount of thought into every detail of what they serve. We got the Pulled Chicken Sandwich, an iced long black, and the ceremonial matcha with oat milk. These might sound like your basic coffee shop order, but talk to the barista about what you ordered and you'll love how much care went into it.
Relaxing place. Cute cafe. Drinks were well prepared and worth the price. Desserts not too sweet. Great woth their coffee

Ordered the Pour Over Ethiopia (Niguse Gemeda) and not exaggerating, it was one of the best cups I have ever had! The barista was very courteous and took the time to answer all my questions. I also love that this shop strayed from the usual Brazil beans, kasi to be honest, nakakaumay na rin minsan. Their Americano was really good too. My only lowlight would be that the place can be a bit tricky to find, especially if you are not from Davao. But overall, I will really miss this spot!

I love the whole place, it’s relaxing and clean. The aroma of the coffee itself is enough to make you stop by.

I recently discovered this hidden gem of a café, and I’m absolutely in love! The ambience is warm, cozy, and effortlessly aesthetic — perfect for quiet mornings or slow, unhurried afternoons, or just a quick break from errands. What truly sets this place apart is the quality and diversity of their coffee beans. Every cup feels like a unique experience, with distinct and well-balanced flavors that highlight their thoughtful sourcing. The staff are also incredibly friendly and accommodating, which makes the whole experience even better.
